title: Adjacency word encodes edges
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine, let $x$ be a bit string, and let $s,n,u,v$ be natural numbers. The raw adjacency relation for the word formed by listing the edge indicators of the graph on $n$ vertices is equivalent to $u<n$, $v<n$, and the existence of an edge from $u$ to $v$ at space parameter $s$.
hypotheses_covered: natural numbers s, n, u, v
